title: Stop requested during a validation interval still allows another attempt
symptom: validate run --times 3 --interval 4 completed 2 attempts after a stop at 1.5 s
trigger: chough validate stop while a repeated run sleeps between attempts
expected: No further attempt starts once a stop or pause exists, including after the wait
actual: The stop file is checked before the sleep only
steps: validate stop during the first interval
impact: Repeated runs continue after the human asked them to stop
source: Review finding D, reproduced 2026-10-31 against main f19823d

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: Stop timing during the interval, not stop between attempts
